title: Eric Walker interview: 'What do you know about ESP?' and the control group

tellings.quote: stuff. And he cuts the guy off. He said, "Look, let me ask you a question. What do you know about ESP?" And the guy had no answer. He said, "Look, unless you understand about ESP and how it works, you will not be taken in by the control group. Very few people understand how it works."

plain: A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron describes a 1987 phone interview with a man named Eric Walker, which he says he has transcripts of. According to Cameron, when the caller pressed him, Walker cut him off and asked, "What do you know about ESP?", meaning extrasensory perception, the idea of sensing things beyond the normal five senses. Walker reportedly said that unless you understand how ESP works, you will never be let in by what he called "the control group", a hint that a hidden circle oversees the UFO secret and treats the mind as the key to it.
